noops.message: Run complete. PR proposed: adds the Deepal E07 (RWD and AWD Performance), Mitsubishi ASX VR-e LS (new make), MG U9 EV and Xpeng X9 (FWD and AWD); validate.mjs passes. Issue opened: the Chery E5 (renamed Omoda E5) DC figure (80 vs 130 kW), plus the Leapmotor B05 left as a candidate. Memory saved: BYD, Alfa Romeo and Deepal re-checked. Still to do: re-check Abarth, Audi, BMW, Cadillac, Cupra, Denza, Fiat, Ford and GAC (their sites blocked automated fetches), and check ROVER (table didn't render), BITRE (download timed out) and the Green Vehicle Guide.

aic.basis: AI credits of errored invocations (measured), of linked follow-up invocations (causal), or the mean healthy-invocation cost (statistical)

latency_ms.basis: wall-clock duration recorded on the failing tool call or invocation

tokens.basis: token classes of the attributed invocations

tool_calls.basis: counted friction occurrences that consumed a tool call

turns.basis: one additional turn per errored or retried model invocation
